decisions.reason: The all-chapters length expectation is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the short-chapter expectation together with its chapter-specific format and audience details.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already includes the applicable short-chapter expectation; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already represents the stated question-and-answer exception to the short-only expectation.
The chapter-length rule does not change which answer layers apply to individual interview questions.
The length expectation for new chapters does not alter the curation rules for the existing question set.
The global-perspective requirement concerns country and industry variation across content and is not itself a chapter whose length is changed by this rule.
The new-chapter length expectation has no effect on the already completed pre-project writing-test deliverables.
Keeping chapters short supports compliance with the word budget but does not change the established 50,000-word cap or its planning figures.
